record.title: uPVC Drainage Pipes - Gravity Drainage Service
record.description:
Specified dimensional, material, jointing, pressure-related, and workmanship requirements for unplasticized PVC drainage pipes used in gravity drainage applications.

Applied to uPVC gravity drainage pipes produced under the earlier demo specification; this record is retained for historical lookup and replacement tracing.

Key requirements: Pipe dimensions and wall thickness shall match the declared size series.; Material shall meet the earlier demo formulation limits.; Jointing surfaces shall remain compatible with the specified connection method.; Pipes shall meet the earlier stiffness and workmanship checks.

Testing requirements: Dimensional and wall-thickness verification.; Ring stiffness screening.; Joint-leakage or watertightness check where applicable.; Visual workmanship inspection.

Documentation required: Historical product specification.; Production test record.; Archived conformity evidence.; Replacement mapping to the current demo standard.

Marking requirements: Manufacturer identification.; Nominal size and class designation.; Batch or production reference.; Earlier standard number marking where historically applied.
record.certification_applicability: Certification applicability followed the conformity route attached to the earlier edition; it is not the current basis for new conformity claims in this demo dataset.
